description: Lists the papers that OpenAlex lists as related to a given paper, so you can find more work on the same topic. Every result carries a one line abstract, so you can judge a paper before you open it. A showing line under the heading says which results are on this page and how many related papers there are in all, with the page to ask for next. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), page (optional, which page of results to show, 1 to 400, 1 by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'what papers are related to DOI 10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762?'

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25.

page.description: Which page of results to show, 1 to 400, 1 by default. Pass the page the showing line names to read the next page.

paper.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807.

name: find_related_papers
title: Find related papers
